hard_read_rulings.1_route6_replaces_gate3_only: KEEP. His Route 6 words open the entrance ('exposing the War Lab for player entrance without action'; 'Nothing the player does bypasses the door, but the Empire fallback does'); they name the door, not the wake. Reading them as also waking the lab would break the 2026-08-30 ruling that players wake it by bringing a core. His card of 2026-11-02 ('Up to what point can the player still call the Cradle strike? -> At the wake, gate 4', with the spec's 'even when Route 6 opened it') already treats the wake as a step after a Route 6 entrance. Application, not reinterpretation.
hard_read_rulings.2_ban_eight: Already ruled by him: card 2026-11-02 'Does ban #8 bind the lab site too? -> Biome map only' (WARLAB_GATES_DECIDE_BAN_EIGHT_ONE_READ closed at 2f3b549b13). Nothing left to judge.
hard_read_rulings.3_clock_starts_at_core: KEEP. The 2026-08-30 ruling makes the core the deliberate wake; §2.10 (judge-kept round 6, shape kept by him 2026-11-02) already says seating the core starts the 15-day clock and that a crew that never wakes the lab never starts it. His strike-cutoff card puts the point of no return at the same gate. Starting the clock at the door would let a crew that only scouts lose the lab, which no ruling asks for.
